title: PRiME: Pragmatic Reasoning In MEntal health
abstract: arXiv:2507.23247v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: In this work, the task and domain interaction of reasoning and mental health are investigated. As large language models (LLMs) present exceptional text understanding and fluent text generation capability, we analyze whether they can reason in the high-stakes domain of mental health. We begin by introducing three datasets and three tasks leveraging the existing work in pragmatic reasoning. The analysis constitutes an evaluation of $12$ LLMs, including MentaLLaMA, which is a mental health reasoning and explanation generation model. The performance of the models remains on par with human evaluation, with the Mistral-7B model giving the best performance. We further analyze the performance of the models with error asymmetry ratio and conduct first-order attention rollout experiment with MentaLLaMA-7B. translated_title: PRiME：心理健康领域的语用推理
translated_abstract: 在这项工作中，我们研究了推理与心理健康领域之间的任务与领域交互问题。鉴于大语言模型（LLMs）展现出卓越的文本理解和流畅的文本生成能力，我们分析了它们能否在心理健康这一高风险领域中进行推理。我们首先基于现有的语用推理研究，引入了三个数据集和三个任务。该分析对12个大语言模型进行了评估，其中包括MentaLLaMA——一个心理健康推理与解释生成模型。这些模型的性能与人类评估水平相当，其中Mistral-7B模型表现最佳。我们进一步使用错误不对称比率分析了模型的性能，并对MentaLLaMA-7B进行了首阶注意力回溯（first-order attention rollout）实验。我们向社区展示了模型针对输入文本的架构行为结果，并建议在相关应用中进一步保持谨慎。
tldr: 该论文提出了PRiME任务与数据集，系统评估了12个大语言模型在高风险心理健康领域的语用推理能力，发现模型表现可与人类评估相当，其中Mistral-7B最佳，并通过错误不对称比率和注意力回溯实验深入分析了模型的架构行为。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces PRiME, featuring three datasets and tasks for pragmatic reasoning in mental health, and evaluates 12 LLMs—showing their performance matches human evaluation with Mistral-7B achieving the best results, while further analyzing model behavior through error asymmetry ratio and attention rollout experiments.
